item.text:
Implemented resilient quote collection with `failedCarrierIds` on both result types. All carriers start once and settle before returning; successful options survive failures. Checkout preserves failure IDs even when filtering removes every option.

Validation, ordering, recommendations, and data isolation remain intact.

Verified: typecheck passed; all 8 tests passed. No blockers. npm emitted a non-fatal existing configuration warning about `home`.
